tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows a nonlinear saturating response, but the fixed horizon and unchanged state variables leave the proposed two-layer bridge mechanism underidentified. The open-branch probe can distinguish the competing mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations vary only u_now, so they cannot identify the bridge dynamics or dependence on the other inputs.
The cheaper open-branch probe is targeted at the unresolved mechanism.
It is not relevant to identifying the bridge mechanism.
